Lenovo LOQ 15 (15APH8) RTX 4060 vs ASUS ROG Strix G16 (G614JJ)

Side-by-side spec analysis, real GPU wattage (TGP) comparison, display quality breakdown, and clear value verdict for Indian buyers.

🏆 Winner Recommendation: Lenovo LOQ 15 (15APH8) RTX 4060

We recommend the Lenovo LOQ 15 (15APH8) RTX 4060 as the overall winner in this matchup due to its higher 115W GPU TGP (vs 95W), superior frame rates in AAA benchmarks. However, consider the ASUS ROG Strix G16 (G614JJ) if you prefer its specific brand ecosystem or aesthetic design.
